digest_contract: SHA-256 on stored UTF-8 bytes with LF line breaks including final newline, no manifest self-digest; any source byte change requires new review and digest.

predicate_ast_rules.reading: COUNT_ROLE refers to spec-v6 allowed symbol-count observation feature; Pos integer 0..16; COMPARE is the shared evaluator construct; not a gifted learned BRANCH
predicate_ast_rules.roles: S0,S1,S2,S3 are canonical hidden roles, not literal G1 symbols, and are bound to live Alphabet via the independent vocabulary-permutation grid.

law_identity.law_id_digest_input: ASCII 'WORLD-LAW-NORMAL-FORM-v1\n' followed by compact JSON encoding of the exact 5-element form; no whitespace or key sorting needed because only arrays/scalars
law_identity.parent_id_digest_input: ASCII 'WORLD-PARENT-CLUSTER-v1\n' followed by compact JSON of [family_id,template_id,signal_role_index,payload_role_index]
law_identity.uniqueness: canonical tuple digest only, NOT an equivalence test on observed outputs; repeated draws of same tuple are the same unique law.

finite_grid.eligible_role_pairs: all ordered (signal,payload) with signal != payload; 12 equiprobable pairs per template
finite_grid.k_probability: uniform within the listed k domain; 0 is a non-parameter sentinel and never interpreted as a repetition count
finite_grid.vocabulary_grid: all 4! = 24 bijections of S0..S3 onto the phase-specific live Alphabet, uniformly sampled; for G1 the live symbols are a fresh injective opaque rename, never a fixed display-label mapping

formulas.HALF_BLOCKS_01: word[i] = S0 if i < floor(L/2), else S1

word_grid.ordering: pattern_ids array order; word index i is zero-based; L is selected phase length; eight distinct words for every L in 4..16
word_grid.sampling: uniform among the eight pre-registered word patterns; no adaptive preference based on result

finite_grid.instance_cell: [law_unique_id,phase,L,vocabulary_permutation_rank_lexicographic_0_to_23,word_pattern_id]; canonical initial buffer = apply bijection to word formula, cursor=0,selection=none,clipboard=empty
finite_grid.instance_sampling: law drawn by exact p_l row; conditional on phase and that law, choose uniformly among structurally admissible lengths; then uniformly among 24 vocabulary bijections and 8 word patterns. No rejection based on solved/failed results, observed scores, or ID-only classifier.
finite_grid.demonstration: three distinct canonical instance cells per law/phase selected without replacement from the same law support by separate PRF domain; demo cells disjoint from scored trial cells; no demo or trial cells are instantiated in this PR
finite_grid.goal_contract: target from deterministic private template function below; public task tag and three input/target demos, feedback only for TRAIN; hidden target/rule unavailable to learner

template_semantics.general: Input x is initial buffer of length L; indexes 0..L-1; P is the registered COUNT_EQ or COUNT_LT comparison on initial x; replace_one leaves other positions unchanged; true/false outputs are private verifier goals. Every output symbol uses the phase live Alphabet. Template evaluation does not provide a BRANCH instance to any learner.
template_semantics.T_HEAD: if P then target=replace_one(x,0,x[L-1]) else target=replace_one(x,0,S<payload>)
template_semantics.T_TAIL: if P then target=replace_one(x,L-1,x[0]) else target=replace_one(x,L-1,S<payload>)
template_semantics.R_HEAD: if P then target=x||repeat(x[0],k) else target=x||repeat(S<payload>,k)
template_semantics.R_TAIL: if P then target=x||repeat(x[L-1],k) else target=x||repeat(S<payload>,k)
template_semantics.O_HEAD: if P then target=replace_one(x,0,S<payload>) else target=replace_one(x,0,S<signal>)
template_semantics.O_TAIL: if P then target=replace_one(x,L-1,S<payload>) else target=replace_one(x,L-1,S<signal>)
template_semantics.C_PREFIX: if P then target=x[k:L]||x[0:k] else target=x[0:k]||x[k:L]
template_semantics.C_SUFFIX: if P then target=x[L-k:L]||x[0:L-k] else target=x[0:L-k]||x[L-k:L]
template_semantics.operations: || is sequence concatenation; repeat(s,k) repeats one live Sym exactly k times; replacement never changes length; slicing uses zero-based half-open indexes. Target function defines evaluator truth, not a learner macro.
template_semantics.target_validity: Only buffer length capacity is structurally screened. Whether target is reachable within T_horizon=24, publicly identifiable, and uniquely demonstrates a second-order witness is deferred to K0 and never assumed from capacity admissibility.

ordering: drop signal==payload before defining law support
for each phase and law-L cell, drop capacity impossible target BEFORE sampling any word/permutation
never drop a law from F merely because an observed trial fails, K0 is UNKNOWN or G2 performance is poor
structural_exclusion.pre_instance_capacity_rule: exclude iff template_id is R_HEAD or R_TAIL AND L+k>16; for the other six templates the target is exactly L symbols and none exceed capacity
structural_exclusion.law_capacity_exclusion_rule: exclude a canonical law from F only if it has zero capacity-admissible instance cells across the registered TRAIN/G1 support (L=4..12). Under this exact grid: zero such laws.
structural_exclusion.G2_repeat_capacity_detail: For each k=1,2,3 there are 48 distinct REPEAT_COPY laws; remove respectively 1,2,3 lengths at the top of G2 13..16, giving 48*(1+2+3)=288 law-length exclusions
structural_exclusion.instance_cell_multiplier: 8 word patterns * 24 symbol bijections = 192 per eligible law-length cell
structural_exclusion.exclusion_entire_grid_application: nested canonical law ID lexicographic, phase in TRAIN/CAL/G1/G2, registered phase length ascending, permutation lexicographic, pattern_id listed order; apply capacity test on law and length before accepting any cell. Exclusion counts multiply by 192 uniformly. These are abstract cell cardinalities only; no real instance bytes or targets are produced.
structural_exclusion.post_generation_rule: Failure, abstention, ACTION_FAULT and FAMILY_UNIDENTIFIABLE remain in denominator; FAMILY_INVALID follows K4 STOP_INVALID, never retroactively modifies F.

distribution.p_l: TRANSCRIBE or OBS_EDIT row 1/192; REPEAT_COPY or TWO_STAGE_JOIN row 1/576. Exact rational p_l is stored in every distribution row. Sum all 384 p_l=1.
distribution.q_l: after sealed parent allocation, for law l in H_laws, q_l=p_l/(sum_{h in H_laws}p_h). No weight is updated using outcomes.
distribution.estimator: Sampford unique-law PPS without replacement, water-filling first order; unnormalized HT; parent cluster re-sampling. No iid repeated law rows.
distribution.proposed_split_design_mass: With quota-based split below, 36 TRANSCRIBE +132 REPEAT_COPY +36 OBS_EDIT +132 TWO_STAGE_JOIN laws are in H, so sum_{H}p=5/6, and conditional q_l is 1/160 or 1/480 respectively; no H law IDs or actual split digests are disclosed here.

parent_cluster_split.parent_identity: cluster root [family_id,template_id,signal_role,payload_role]; predicate_id and k are descendants, all descendants stay in exactly one split. 24 parents/family, 96 total.
parent_cluster_split.assignment_seed_policy: Parent assignment is sealed. Owner must escrow distinct 256-bit key AFTER separate authorization under the protocol's seed policy; the key value, assignments, H_laws IDs, real instances and targets do not appear here.
parent_cluster_split.assignment_rank: for each family independently, sort all 24 parent IDs by unsigned 256-bit HMAC-SHA256(split_key, UTF-8('WORLD-PARENT-SPLIT-v1\n'+parent_cluster_id)), ties by ASCII parent_cluster_id; do not use observed outcomes or generator seed
parent_cluster_split.assignment_rule: per family: first TRAIN parent quota => TRAIN; next CAL quota => CAL; remaining => HOLDOUT; expand each parent to its entire family of descendant unique laws; no cross-split ancestor or derivation
parent_cluster_split.split_manifest_pending: digest values MUST be computed from a later authorized sealed allocation, must be checked against these count invariants and never inferred from this source-only draft. The actual instance sample must remain sealed.

random_source_spec.prf_version: HMAC-SHA256 counter PRF; protocol WORLD-CAL-v1; domain separation between split, law, instance, demo, tag, CAL simulation, bootstrap
random_source_spec.seed_escrow_path: owner-private/escrow/WORLD-CAL-v1 (reference namespace only; no real secret/path or seed instantiated)
random_source_spec.tag_rule: per phase, keyed PRF independent from generator and split secrets over canonical law ID plus collision counter; 128-bit opaque lower-case hexadecimal IDs, reject and increment counter on collision within phase; same law gets same tag within phase, different laws never share; phases use independent domain; IDs contain no role/name bits

sampling_design.pi_ll_method: Sampford exact second order inclusion, implementation pending audit

runtime_manifest_contract.failure_log_schema: CAL protocol §7.2 action_event/family_status/run_status; fail-closed; raw trace + digest; no holdout scoring prior to separate GO
runtime_manifest_contract.stage_gates: No CAL, power simulation, K0 full run, holdout materialization, algorithm lock, FROZEN, implementation GO, or experiment GO is implied. Runtime-only digest/receipt fields remain null until separately authorized.
